title: Color / Full palette — PMS specifications

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: PMS

slide_intent: Connect digital color names to print references, because the same brand color needs to remain identifiable when the production method changes.
strategic_value: Mapping IBM’s named swatches to Pantone references can give print partners a common starting point for color reproduction.
demonstration: The PMS tab replaces channel numbers with Pantone references across the same hue and neutral swatch families; White is shown with a dash.
practical_value: Find the listed Pantone reference for a named IBM grade rather than substituting an unrecorded screen-to-print conversion.

content_islands.name: Print-reference selector
content_islands.spec: Show PMS selected among the four encoding tabs.

content_islands.name: Chromatic references
content_islands.spec: Pair the seven hue families with Pantone names or numbers, including Blue 60 with 2132.

content_islands.name: Neutral references
content_islands.spec: List cool, neutral and warm gray mappings with Black 6 and dash entries for White.

reference_purposes.Expression: The palette retains its family and tonal organization while displaying print references.
reference_purposes.Application: The selected tab supplies Pantone mappings for the named IBM colors; the accompanying page identifies these as print specifications.
